rows.en: Touya: "Ugh... Where am I...? !! Yamato!"
Touya: "Melvi! Is anyone here?!"
Touya: "Ai! Is anyone here?!"
Touya: "Kasumi! Is anyone here?!"
Touya: "Aurelie! Is anyone here?!"
Touya: "Celica! Is anyone here?!"
Touya: "Melissa! Is anyone here?!"
Touya: "H-hey, isn't... anyone here...?
...Did I... die after all...?"
Touya: "...Hm? What's that scent...?
...Perfume?"
Ymir: "Yes. Though Rayblade still hasn't been fully
repaired, so we can't use it yet."
Touya: "Oh... Hm? That scent..."
Ymir: "Oh, this? Lady Ivel gave it to me.
It smells nice, doesn't it?"
Touya: "It's the same scent as back then..."
?????: "It's been a while, Touya Kazami."
Touya: "You're..."
?????: "Thank you for saving Ymir, my daughter."
Touya: "Your daughter...? I see. You're Wenimas.
...Wait a minute. Didn't Wenimas, 29 years ago..."
Wenimas: "Yes. I was thrown forward to this time 29 years ago.
That's when I met Ivel.
Then I gave birth to Ymir and lost my body..."
Touya: "Lost your body...?
Y-you mean you died?! Then this really is..."
Wenimas: "Don't worry. You aren't dead yet.
And this place is a 'Rift in Time,' created
by the aftereffects of Vorlia's power."
Touya: "What do you mean, 'yet'...?"
Wenimas: "Right now, you exist as a disembodied consciousness.
But your body should still be there.
So it's a little different from being dead.
But if your consciousness stays separated from your body,
eventually your connection to it will be severed, and you won't be able to return."
Touya: "H-hey, then I've got to get back fast..."
Wenimas: "It's all right. You can go back.
There are people waiting for you on the other side.
So just wait a little."
Touya: "So there's no point in getting worked up..."
Wenimas: "That's right. Besides, I need you to return..."
Touya: "? Come to think of it... Haven't we met before?
Oh, I don't mean anything weird. I really feel like we have..."
Wenimas: "Hee hee. Yes. At your school."
Touya: "I thought so... Your face is different,
but you give off the same feeling..."
Wenimas: "I was only borrowing that person's body."
Touya: "...You're going to explain
what's going on, right?"
Wenimas: "Yes. As I said,
I've already lost my body.
When the explosion happened 109 years ago, I was thrown
80 years into the future. At the same time, I gained the ability
to 'see' worlds on the same timeline.
As though drawn to strong Prana, that ability
showed me you and the others.
But all I could do was 'see.'
Information came to me in only one direction.
At the time, I was desperate.
What if Dr. Debish had also leaped through time?
What if he'd gained powers like mine?
He should at least appear at a later time than I did,
so I thought I had to act as quickly as possible.
Then... I realized that my body
was binding my ability to this world...
So I freed my mind.
I abandoned my body and became a disembodied consciousness."
Touya: "You mean you killed yourself?"
Wenimas: "No. Though perhaps the result
is the same, death and liberation are different.
I was freed from the constraints of this world's laws."
Touya: "Hmm... I don't really get it,
but can anyone do that?"
Wenimas: "No. Even I could only do it
with the help of the Frail Crystal's power...
Dr. Debish originally developed this method
in the course of his research on Ze=Ode."
Touya: "Come to think of it, that bastard Debish said he'd free humanity
from its bodies and unite everyone as disembodied consciousnesses."
Wenimas: "He wants to bring all of humanity
together as a single consciousness. That would mean
the end of individual existence."
Touya: "I see. So that's why you and Dr. Lenis..."
Wenimas: "No one has the right to do that.
He never used to be the sort of person who'd say such things...
Not until he discovered Goderius and got inside it..."
Touya: "Huh? You mean you didn't
build the Ze=Ode units?"
Wenimas: "No. They were discovered in ruins,
and we were brought together to research them.
Then, after we succeeded in activating Goderius experimentally,
Dr. Debish changed completely,
as though something had possessed him."
Touya: "This is getting pretty confusing,
but I get that you became a disembodied consciousness.
So why were you at my school?"
Wenimas: "Because Dr. Debish and the others
leaped through time. Three years ago."
Touya: "...Then the explosion three years ago..."
Wenimas: "It was an aftereffect of their leap.
Fortunately, they weren't in any condition to act right away.
So I traveled to a world connected to Agarthia,
found people there with strong Prana,
and arranged for them to be summoned here."
Touya: "Then Clovis and I and the others didn't come here
by chance. You did it?"
Wenimas: "I'm sorry I brought you here against your will.
Please forgive me. But this was the only way
I could save the world. Touya... Please.
Stop Debish.
Save the world. Save Agarthia... The only ones who can
are you and the person
you cherish most..."
Touya: "The person I cherish most..."
Wenimas: "Yes. That's why Rayblade has two seats.
Your feelings will unleash Rayblade's true power."
Touya: "Is that why you rode Rayblade with Lenis,
instead of Lyle?"
Wenimas: "...I love him. I love Lyle.
I still do."
Touya: "Huh...?"
Wenimas: "Lenis simply agreed with what I believed.
He was a good partner. But Lyle misunderstood...
No matter what I said, Lyle wouldn't believe me.
But I've never loved anyone other than Lyle."
Touya: "Then... Ymir is..."
Wenimas: "You can't betray
someone you truly love. I wanted to save him...
Save him from the path to destruction..."
Wenimas: "I-I seem to be at my limit.
Touya, please take care of Ymir, and this world...
I'll be waiting for you to come back..."
Touya: "Hey! Wait a minute...
What do you mean, you'll be waiting?!"
Touya: "H-hey... Ugh... What's this feeling...?"
Touya: "Ugh... Hah! What was that..."
?????: "...You're finally awake."
Touya: "!! Wh-who are you?!"
Touya: "Whoa! I-I'm floating?!
Where am I?! Why am I in a place like..."
?????: "Heh heh... You don't need to worry.
This is a 'Rift in Time.' You've only been sent here
temporarily."
Touya: "Huh? Then what happened before really was...
H-hey, there was a woman here, wasn't there?"
?????: "No. I've been alone here all this time.
It's been three years since I came here. You're my first visitor."
Touya: "Hmm. What the hell's going on?"
?????: "Perhaps you were in a different
'rift.' Apparently this isn't
the only place like it."
Touya: "Oh, I see... Wait, how do you
know that?"
?????: "My roommate told me."
Touya: "Huh? But you said you were the only one here."
?????: "You're here now, though..."
Touya: "No, that's not what I meant..."
?????: "Heh heh... You're amusing.
And I can feel a strong power of affection directed toward you."
Touya: "Affection directed toward me?"
?????: "Yes, affection directed toward you...
That power will guide you out of the rift you've wandered into...
Someone who thinks only of you..."
Touya: "Someone who cares about me..."
?????: "Now, remember...
The person who cares about you, and only you..."
Touya: "Someone who cares only about me..."
Melvi: "Big Brother!"
Ai: "Touya!"
Kasumi: "Touya-chan."
Aurelie: "Touya."
Celica: "Touya."
Melissa: "Touya."
Ai: "Touya!"
Ymir: "Touya."
Kasumi: "Touya-chan."
Aurelie: "Touya."
Melvi: "Big Brother!"
Leone: "Touya."
Kururu: "Touya."
Melissa: "Touya."
Celica: "Touya."
Touya: "Hah!"
?????: "...The power directed toward you is growing stronger...
Someone must be calling you."
Touya: "Does that mean I can go back?"
?????: "...Probably. It looks like I can go back now too."
Touya: "Come to think of it, why are you here?"
?????: "I was caught in the explosion three years ago.
But I don't regret it. Thanks to that,
I found what I must do, and gained the power to do it.
Now I almost feel grateful."
Touya: "Power?"
?????: "It's what saved me from the depths of despair."
Touya: "That's...?! Wh-what's this feeling...?"
?????: "It seems it's time to say goodbye.
Now, picture that person once more. The one
you cherish, who cherishes you in return."
Touya: "Y-yeah..."
Picture someone else.
Picture Ai.
Picture Kasumi.
Picture someone else.
Picture Celica.
Picture Aurelie.
Picture someone else.
Picture Ymir.
Picture someone else.
Picture Ymir.
Picture Melvi.
?????: "...See you later..."
Touya: "!!"

review_batches.context: Entire member read. Touya's isolation/partner calls, perfume recollection, concealed Wenimas reveal, 29-year arrival and explanation of disembodied consciousness/time travel.
review_batches.decisions: Preserve alternate partner calls and flashback without invented headings. Keep five-question-mark label until revealed, 109/80/29-year relationships, tentative body state, strong-Prana observation limits and fantasy liberation distinction. Frail Crystal is not silently equated with Resonance Crystal or Frail Barrier.

row_decisions.scenario.s_01a.o0022a.l00: That scent is deliberately incomplete recognition.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01a.o002c0.l00: Keep exactly five question marks as source concealed label until Wenimas is named. Japanese surname-first becomes established English full-name order.

row_decisions.scenario.s_01a.o0047c.l04: Severance risk is fantasy explanation, not a real-world medical claim or method.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01a.o0052f.l00: Wenimas reassures him based on people waiting; no exact return time promised.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01a.o0059e.l00: Need you to return remains intentionally unfinished motive.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01a.o005c6.l01: Touya clarifies he really recognizes her, rather than using a romantic pickup line.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01a.o006b1.l00: That person's body remains unnamed. Do not infer identity or gender from the borrowed face.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01a.o00703.p01.l00: Explosion 109 years ago followed by eighty-year forward leap yields arrival 29 years ago. All source values retained.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01a.o00703.p01.l02: See worlds on same timeline is her description. Do not replace with modern multiverse mechanics or real physics claims.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01a.o00703.p01.l03: As though drawn preserves the source's simile about the ability and Prana, not a fully established mechanism.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01a.o00703.p01.l05: See is marked as a limited ability, contrasted with unilateral information reception.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01a.o00703.p02.l00: Two what-if fears concern Debish's leap and similar powers; preserve as concerns, not established acquisition of identical powers.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01a.o00703.p03.l00: Later arrival is Wenimas's expectation, not a newly calculated absolute timeline.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01a.o00703.p04.l01: Body constrains her ability is her explanation, not a real technique.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01a.o00703.p04.l02: Fantasy liberation remains an asserted act with no added physical method.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01a.o008dd.l00: Touya asks directly about suicide; do not euphemize or certify his interpretation. Wenimas distinguishes it in next reply.

row_decisions.scenario.s_01a.o0098a.l00: Only possible with Frail Crystal's power is fictional limitation, not actionable real-world instruction.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01a.o0098a.l01: Frail Crystal follows existing Frail transliteration but is separately named; no identity with Resonance Crystal or barrier inferred.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01a.o009fa.l00: Bodies plural in Touya's paraphrase, then singular consciousness in Wenimas's precise explanation. Preserve the clarification.
